remarks: Immaculate and bright Wilton townhouse within walking distance to downtown! Glen River is one of Wilton's most popular complexes and this unit has a lot to offer. Besides the gorgeous pool, high ceilings and private parking, this well maintained unit has a spacious living area with two levels perfect for entertaining. The fireplace sets the mood for a cold winters day or enjoy your own private patio with brand new sliding doors. It's one of the best in the complex!! The first floor den could also be used as a 3rd bedroom or home office. Upstairs, there are 2 large bedrooms with walk-in closets and two large full baths. Laundry is also on the second level. The unit also has new windows (2022), roof & siding (2022), HVAC(2020) New water heater(2020). Come check out everything Wilton has to offer!
